Logs, metrics, traces, runbooks, prior incidents — this data is large, fragmented, and doesn’t fit cleanly into an LLM context window. For logs, we don’t fetch everything. We start with stats (counts, severity distribution, common patterns) and then sample intentionally (errors-only, around-anomaly, stratified). Most investigations end up with tens of logs instead of millions. items.title: Circe – Deterministic, offline-verifiable receipts for AI agent actions
items.raw_excerpt:
I’ve been working on a small primitive for agentic systems: a cryptographically signed receipt that records what an AI agent decided, what it did, and what changed — as a single canonical JSON artifact. The problem:
Agent systems today rely on logs, dashboards, or proprietary consoles for truth. Those are easy to forge, truncate, or lose. If an agent takes a high-stakes action (e.g. a firewall change, a deployment, a purchase), there’s no portable artifact you can independently verify later. The idea:
Treat agent execution like a signed transaction, not a log stream. Each run emits a receipt that can be verified offline, without trusting the issuer’s infrastructure. How it works (minimal core): Deterministic signing: Ed25519 signatures over a canonical JSON byte string Canonicalization: RF

items.title: Agent 不是渐进升级，而是要“换代”了：Cursor 工程负责人放话未来三到六个月，行业将迎来大变局
items.raw_excerpt: 如果把时间拨回到一年前，Agent 还主要停留在代码补全、对话式改几行代码的阶段；而今天，在 Cursor 内部，工程师已经开始同时运行多个 Agent 并行“甩活儿”，让它们在代码库中自主修改、调试、复盘，再由人类在最后阶段集中审核结果。开发者不再盯着 Agent 的每一步操作，而是开始习惯“等它跑完再看答案”。

title_i18n.zh: Agent 不是渐进升级，而是要“换代”了：Cursor 工程负责人放话未来三到六个月，行业将迎来大变局
title_i18n.en: Agents are not about incremental upgrades but rather a "generational shift": the Cursor engineering lead predicts that the industry will undergo a major transformation in the next three to six months.
title_i18n.es: El agente no es una actualización gradual, sino un "cambio de generación": el responsable de ingeniería de Cursor anuncia que en los próximos tres a seis meses, la industria experimentará una gran transformación.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 如果把时间拨回到一年前，Agent 还主要停留在代码补全、对话式改几行代码的阶段；而今天，在 Cursor 内部，工程师已经开始同时运行多个 Agent 并行“甩活儿”，让它们在代码库中自主修改、调试、复盘，再由人类在最后阶段集中审核结果。开发者不再盯着 Agent 的每一步操作，而是开始习惯“等它跑完再看答案”。
excerpt_i18n.en: If we rewind to a year ago, Agents were primarily limited to code completion and conversational editing of a few lines of code. Today, within Cursor, engineers have started running multiple Agents in parallel to "delegate tasks," allowing them to autonomously modify, debug, and review code in the repository, with humans only stepping in to review the results at the final stage. Developers no longer monitor every step of an Agent's operation but are instead growing accustomed to "waiting for it to finish and then checking the answer."
excerpt_i18n.es: Si retrocedemos un año, los Agent se limitaban principalmente a completar código y modificar unas pocas líneas mediante conversación; hoy, en Cursor, los ingenieros ya ejecutan múltiples Agent en paralelo para "delegar tareas", permitiéndoles modificar, depurar y revisar de forma autónoma en el repositorio de código, mientras los humanos supervisan los resultados en la etapa final. Los desarrolladores ya no supervisan cada paso del Agent, sino que se acostumbran a "esperar a que termine para ver los resultados".

On January 19, 2026, Anker Innovations and Feishu jointly launched the latest AI hardware—the Anker AI Recording Pod, with Feishu providing the software AI adaptation and services for the product. This device features an extremely lightweight magnetic button design for unobtrusive wearable use. Leveraging Feishu's AI capabilities, it supports voiceprint recognition, real-time transcription and translation, real-time AI visual summaries, and smart meeting minutes generation. Combined with Feishu's knowledge Q&A, it transforms recordings into collaborative and transferable knowledge assets.

The AI Recording Pod has a diameter of 23.2 millimeters, comparable to the size of a coin, and weighs only 10 grams. In this form factor, users can carry it as a lapel clip or pendant, making it more portable than traditional voice recorders or recording cards and suitable for a wider range of scenarios. The device is equipped with two omnidirectional microphones with an effective pickup radius of 5 meters. Paired with intelligent noise reduction algorithms, it accurately filters background noise even in noisy environments, delivering clear voice reproduction. In terms of battery life, it supports 8 hours of continuous recording, and with the charging case, the total recording time extends to 32 hours, meeting all-day recording needs.

With Feishu's AI adaptation and services, this product further supports real-time speaker voiceprint recognition, multilingual transcription, real-time AI visual summaries, and can generate multimodal AI meeting minutes with text and images after meetings. Recording content and AI-generated minutes can be automatically saved as personal assets in Feishu.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 19 de enero de 2026, Anker Innovations y Feishu lanzaron conjuntamente el último hardware de IA: Anker AI Recording Bean, con Feishu proporcionando la adaptación de software de IA y servicios para este producto. Este dispositivo, con una forma extremadamente ligera de "botón magnético", permite un uso discreto y portátil. Basado en las capacidades de IA de Feishu, admite reconocimiento de voz, transcripción y traducción en tiempo real, resumen visual de IA en tiempo real y generación inteligente de actas. Combinado con el sistema de preguntas y respuestas de conocimiento de Feishu, convierte las grabaciones en activos de conocimiento colaborativos y transferibles. El AI Recording Bean tiene un diámetro de 23,2 milímetros, similar al tamaño de una moneda.

With the widespread application of AI tools in the natural sciences, an increasing number of studies can be completed in shorter timeframes, leading to higher paper output and citation returns. In an academic system where publication quantity, impact, and speed are core metrics, this efficiency advantage is directly influencing researchers' behavioral choices and the layout of research directions. excerpt_i18n.en:
Recently, Dongyi Technology announced the completion of a 100-million-yuan-level Angel++ round of financing, bringing its cumulative angel round funding to over 200 million yuan. This round continues to reflect strong capital recognition of Dongyi Technology's "full-stack self-developed" technical approach and "superhuman" dynamic performance achievements. Investors in this round include Haizhu Chengfa, Guangzhou Chantou, Jinyu Maowu, Xichuang Tou, Jinshajiang United, Datai Capital, and Fuzhuo Investment, with existing shareholder Puchao Capital making an additional follow-on investment.  

As a rising player in embodied AI founded just over a year ago, Dongyi Technology has secured multiple rounds of capital support thanks to its "full-stack self-developed" technical barriers and differentiated product strategy. This latest funding will further accelerate the iteration of general-purpose humanoid robots and core joint module technologies, advance commercialization across multiple scenarios, and expand its global footprint.  

By building core barriers through full-stack self-development, Dongyi Technology’s product matrix meets diverse scenario needs. Since its establishment in September 2024, the company has adhered to the vision of "Robot for AI," with a core strategy centered on "full-stack self-development." It has built closed-loop capabilities from underlying hardware to software systems, driving the transition of artificial intelligence from "cognitive intelligence" to "embodied intelligence," and has established differentiated competitiveness in the industry.  

Pioneering a unique path of "general motion control model × embodied body":  
On the software side, the new generation of end-to-end motion control models eliminates the need to break down subtasks and can directly output robot joint control commands, significantly improving motion generalization and robustness, and addressing issues such as "rigid movements and poor scenario adaptability" in traditional robots.  
On the hardware side, the globally innovative third-generation PhyArc series joint modules are hailed as the "hexagonal warriors among joints."
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, Dongyi Technology anunció la finalización de una ronda de financiación ángel++ de cientos de millones de yuanes, acumulando una financiación total en la ronda ángel de más de 200 millones de yuanes. Esta ronda refleja el continuo alto reconocimiento por parte del capital hacia la ruta tecnológica de "desarrollo propio de pila completa" y los logros de rendimiento dinámico "sobrehumano" de Dongyi Technology. Los inversores de esta ronda incluyen Haizhu Chengfa, Guangzhou Chantou, Jinyu Maowu, Xichuang Tou, Jinshajiang United, Datai Capital y Fuzhuo Investment, mientras que el accionista existente, Puchao Capital, realizó una inversión adicional excedente. Como una nueva fuerza en inteligencia encarnada con poco más de un año desde su fundación, Dongyi Technology, gracias a su barrera tecnológica de "desarrollo propio de pila completa" y su diferenciada disposición de productos, ha recibido múltiples apoyos de capital. Esta financiación acelerará aún más la iteración tecnológica de robots humanoides universales y módulos de articulaciones centrales, así como la comercialización en múltiples escenarios.

excerpt_i18n.en:
On the afternoon of January 18, the 2025 National College Student Computer System Capability Competition and the 5th OceanBase Database Competition concluded at the University of Science and Technology Beijing. This year's event attracted 1,223 teams and 2,620 students from universities across the country. After over two months of competition, the "Programming Experts" team from Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications won the championship and a 100,000 yuan prize, thanks to their comprehensive performance in database kernel optimization and AI application development.  

The OceanBase Database Competition was launched in 2021 and was integrated into the National College Student Computer System Capability Competition system in 2023, recognized as a Class A academic competition by the Ministry of Education. This year's competition was initiated by the System Capability Cultivation Research Expert Group and jointly organized by the National Higher Education Computer Education Research Association and the System Capability Cultivation Research Project Demonstration Universities. It was co-hosted by the University of Science and Technology Beijing and OceanBase. Over the past five years, the competition has covered more than 500 universities and over 11,000 students, becoming a key platform for cultivating core talent in China's database field.  

Currently, large models and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technologies are accelerating their implementation, and enterprise AI applications are placing new demands on data systems: they must support hybrid queries such as semantic retrieval and structured filtering, while also meeting governance requirements like access control, traceability, and consistency, ensuring AI "answers accurately, runs quickly, and operates stably." The industry believes that the traditional "search engine + database" patchwork architecture struggles to meet the demands of large-scale applications in terms of latency, complexity, and data consistency, while natively supporting hybrid queries and multimodal retrieval.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 18 de enero por la tarde, la Competencia Nacional de Habilidades de Sistemas Informáticos para Estudiantes Universitarios 2025 y la quinta edición del Concurso de Bases de Datos OceanBase concluyeron en la Universidad de Ciencia y Tecnología de Beijing. Este evento atrajo la participación de 1.223 equipos y 2.620 estudiantes de universidades de todo el país. Tras más de dos meses de competición, el equipo "Expertos en Programación" de la Universidad de Correos y Telecomunicaciones de Beijing se alzó con el campeonato y un premio de 100.000 yuanes, gracias a su destacado desempeño en la optimización del núcleo de bases de datos y el desarrollo de aplicaciones de IA. El Concurso de Bases de Datos OceanBase, iniciado en 2021, se integró en 2023 en el sistema de la Competencia Nacional de Habilidades de Sistemas Informáticos para Estudiantes Universitarios, siendo reconocido como una competición académica de categoría A por el Ministerio de Educación. Esta edición fue organizada por la Investigación para el Desarrollo de Habilidades de Sistemas.

items.title: 欧洲科学院院士刘向阳：许多企业的数字化底座，配不上今天的AI发展 | GAIR 2025
items.raw_excerpt: 2025年12月12-13日，第八届GAIR全球人工智能与机器人大会在深圳·博林天瑞喜来登酒店正式启幕。 作为AI 产学研投界的标杆盛会，GAIR自2016年创办以来，始终坚守“传承+创新”内核，始终致力于连接技术前沿与产业实践。 在人工智能逐步成为国家竞争核心变量的当下，算力正以前所未有的速度重塑技术路径与产业结构。13日举办的“AI 算力新十年”专场聚焦智能体系的底层核心——算力，从架构演进、生态构建到产业化落地展开系统讨论，试图为未来十年的中国AI产业，厘清关键变量与发展方向。 会上，欧洲科学院院士、美的首席信息安全官兼软件工程院院长、IEEE Fellow、IET  Fellow、ACM杰出科学家刘向阳，在大会上带来题为《中立云：赋能AI与AI赋能的多云统一数字化底座》的主题演讲，分享了美的在企业级数字化与AI实践中的真实路径。   深耕数字化与信息安全领域的刘向阳，曾任职蚂蚁集团首席科学家、美国高校教授，如今在美的集团主导数字化底座与信息安全建设。他敏锐指出，当前多数企业在 AI 落地中面临 “数字化底座薄弱” 的核心问题——若将数字化比作建筑，底座如同地基，直接决定 AI 价值的上限。 围绕“地基”该怎么打，他直指企业常见的两条路径：自建数据中心，或全面上公有云。前者看似成本低，但现实往往事与愿违，“如果一个CIO真能把数字化底座建得非常好，那他其实已经可以去开一家公有云了。”在他看来，多数企业的自建底座仍停留在上世纪90年代的虚拟化技术，存在技术老旧、产品杂乱、稳定性和安全性难以保障的问题。 而公有云看似先进，却又带来了另一组难题：多云几乎是大型企业的必然选择，美的目前使用的云超过8朵，但彼此之间互不兼容，且迁移难、联动难，最终形成云孤岛、数据孤岛。在业内，一个数字化应用的跨云迁移通常需要至少半年以上。 正是这样的背景下， 刘向阳带领美的选

excerpt_i18n.zh: 2025年12月12-13日，第八届GAIR全球人工智能与机器人大会在深圳·博林天瑞喜来登酒店正式启幕。 作为AI 产学研投界的标杆盛会，GAIR自2016年创办以来，始终坚守“传承+创新”内核，始终致力于连接技术前沿与产业实践。 在人工智能逐步成为国家竞争核心变量的当下，算力正以前所未有的速度重塑技术路径与产业结构。13日举办的“AI 算力新十年”专场聚焦智能体系的底层核心——算力，从架构演进、生态构建到产业化落地展开系统讨论，试图为未来十年的中国AI产业，厘清关键变量与发展方向。 会上，欧洲科学院院士、美的首席信息安全官兼软件工程院院长、IEEE Fellow、IET  Fellow、ACM杰出科学家刘向阳，在大会上带来题为《中立云：赋能AI与AI赋能的多云统一数字化底座》的主题演讲，分享了美的在企业级数字化与AI实践中的真实路径。   深耕数字化与信息安全领域的刘向阳，曾任职蚂蚁集团首席科学家、美国高校教授，如今在美的集团主导数字化底座与信息安全建设。他敏锐指出，当前多数企业在 AI 落地中面临 “数字化底座薄弱” 的核心问题——若将数字化比作建筑，底座如同地基，直接决定 AI 价值的上限。 围绕“地基”该怎么打，他直指企业常见的两条路径：自建数据中心，或全面上公有云。前者看似成本低，但现实往往事与愿违，“如果一个CIO真能把数字化底座建得非常好，那他其实已经可以去开一家公有云了。”在他看来，多数企业的自建底座仍停留在上世纪90年代的虚拟化技术，存在技术老旧、产品杂乱、稳定性和安全性难以保障的问题。 而公有云看似先进，却又带来了另一组难题：多云几乎是大型企业的必然选择，美的目前使用的云超过8朵，但彼此之间互不兼容，且迁移难、联动难，最终形成云孤岛、数据孤岛。在业内，一个数字化应用的跨云迁移通常需要至少半年以上。 正是这样的背景下， 刘向阳带领美的选
excerpt_i18n.en: On December 12-13, 2025, the 8th GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Summit officially commenced at the Sheraton Shenzhen Boao Tianrui Hotel. As a benchmark event in the AI industry-academia-research-investment community, GAIR has consistently adhered to the core principle of "heritage + innovation" since its inception in 2016, dedicated to bridging cutting-edge technology with industrial practice. With artificial intelligence increasingly becoming a core variable in national competition, computing power is reshaping technological pathways and industrial structures at an unprecedented pace. The "AI Computing Power: The Next Decade" session held on the 13th focused on computing power—the foundational core of intelligent systems—engaging in systematic discussions from architectural evolution and ecosystem development to industrial implementation, aiming to clarify key variables and development directions for China's AI industry over the next decade. At the summit, Liu Xiangyang, Academician of the European Academy of Sciences, Chief Information Security Officer and Dean of the Software Engineering Institute at Midea Group, IEEE Fellow, IET Fellow, and ACM Distinguished Scientist, delivered a keynote speech titled "Neutral Cloud: A Unified Multi-Cloud Digital Foundation Empowering AI and Empowered by AI," sharing Midea's practical journey in enterprise digitalization and AI implementation. With deep expertise in digitalization and information security, Liu Xiangyang previously served as Chief Scientist at Ant Group and as a professor at a U.S. university, now leading digital foundation and information security initiatives at Midea Group. He astutely pointed out that many enterprises currently face the core challenge of a "weak digital foundation" in AI implementation—if digitalization is likened to a building, the foundation is akin to the ground.
